To do this we need: legal name, registered address, VAT number (if registered), preferred invoice contact email, and the PO or billing reference to appear on invoices. Please populate the VAT_Reregistration_Form and return it.

2) VAT handling: Redwood can issue invoices either with Redwood US details and reverse-charge wording or with Redwood EU VAT info (requires we onboard an EU billing entity). We currently support reverse-charge language by default for EU customers where applicable; if you need invoices originating from an EU entity (to show an EU VAT number), that requires an onboarding step and a short approval from Finance / Legal on our side.

3) SOW amendment: we can countersign. Marissa — can you confirm the small amendment we need to attach (billing appendix only)?
